The place was extremely bad, and the staff had the worst behavior I’ve ever seen. The worst thing was that during online booking they asked for my phone and gave a rating themselves—I don’t even know what they did because my rating is not showing anywhere. I paid in cash, and they said they didn’t have change and would return it at checkout. Even then, they only returned some money after I kept asking again and again, otherwise they wouldn’t have given it back at all. The AC wasn’t working, the room wasn’t clean, and in the bathroom people had even spit after chewing tobacco. I want this hotel to be removed from the listing, otherwise a heavy penalty should be imposed because their only purpose is to trouble the guests. This was the worst experience ever.
